ops.value: Uses logical follow-up questions: a question that builds on the customer's previous answer (e.g. after hearing "we can arrange around ₹4 lakh", asking how much of it can be used comfortably). A new, unrelated topic is not a follow-up.
ops.why: D7: one-line check descriptions were too vague to judge consistently; live assessments missed clear follow-ups. Definition and example added, same intent.

ops.value: Responds to the customer concern: when the customer voices a worry (e.g. a heavy EMI, not wanting to use all savings), the learner acknowledges it or asks about it before moving on.
